normalization: Exact persisted previous Mic F P99 values, inherited without refit
chunking: 8-connected components, partition by absolute 32x32 pixel tiles; keep every tile of parent component >=3 pixels
objective_weight: each nonempty chunk has equal weight; pixel weight proportional to evidence within chunk; each F/class total 1/24; empty class weight zero, no reassignment
nonedge_grid: all original native800 foreground rays, not subsampled
completeness_scope: each of all16 F, weighted major uses frozen balanced omega; p10 unweighted union MAJOR foreground rays; report perclass and fullforeground/detail/offedge tails

arms.A: Exact historical TOP4 baseline_union; same algorithm newly computed from each scene F, inherited historical Mic-only evidence normalization
arms.B: expanded-K independent ratio: balanced major sum(omega*w/fullalpha) / equal-view foreground mean(w/fullalpha)

leakage_cost: per-ID mean(w/fullalpha) over each view foreground offedge rays, zero for absent ID; average over eight F; preserve raw full-grid mass and class counterevidence
early_stop: net marginal <=1e-15; no padding; all count mismatches explicit, baseline at actual joint count additionally evaluated
coverage_matching: F utility at A middle budget; earliest available prefix attaining it, otherwise null; chosen before any C/arc raw reads
projection: native full original model opacity/transmittance, fixed ID fields, black bg; RGB SH0 clipped DC white bg; no deletion, no perview masking or clipping
display: original Q contribution white-to-black; gain1 all arms, no ink mass matching
evaluation: all8F+all8C all three budgets and count/coverage matched operatingpoints; all33arc middle budget all5arms; full native field projection required for final comparisons
budget_rule: historical legacy_core.rank_tiers: ceil(old TOP4 A eligible count * [1,3,10]/100), same original-ID counts all arms; sealed before selection
